write: external 14 times 2 followed by 6 unforced ticks
query: slot address generated only after hold completion; two spike updates over selected five modules
readout: unique count winner per bit; ties invalid; canonical (1,0)/(0,1) phase validity separate
delay_pairing: reset pattern/query RNG to identical seed for each delay; same utterances and addresses
encoder_selection: use all five frozen encoders; no test-seed selection
baseline: ideal digital register, explicitly different direct-write/clear semantics
scope: derived SHD four-utterance delayed class-selection and reuse; not end-to-end spiking classification
amendment: After v1/v2 measurement audits: use permissive readout, pair delays, freeze new task/query seeds. This remains an exploratory pilot with no model selection on task test results.
